items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 – Weekly Files (Sept 2026 – Aug 2027)
items.big_idea: A curated, ready-to-use set of weekly house fellowship study guides for the 2026/2027 RCCG year (HTML + PDF). Open the index to browse all 52 weeks.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 01: Forget Not God's Benefits
items.big_idea: The Psalmist reminded us in Psalm 103 of God's provisions for humanity that should not be winked at, starting with privileges of waking up daily, getting air not being paid for, the human anatomy working effectively, and deliverance from wicked forces and their antics, anyone that rules out this awesome kindness of God should be reminded of John 15:4 that w…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 02: Remember Lot's Wife
items.big_idea: Lot's wife may not be known in the bible for many reasons but her tragic end by becoming a pillar of salt has always brought people's attention to her attachment to worldly allures, covetousness and indiscipline, despite angels' strong warning to her family to flee the city and never to look back after God released destruction into Sodom and Gomorrah she di…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 03: Then and Now
items.big_idea: The story of the wedding in Cana of Galilee tells us that an unrelenting attitude pays, it yields positive ending, but one major take home in that story is getting Jesus into your daily endeavor. When the wedding was drawing towards a shameful ending due to the exhaustion of resources, His presence changed the ridiculous tune to a miraculous melody. Your th…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 04: God's Favourite
items.big_idea: Being God's favourite means you are divinely, most preferred above others: And being divinely chosen over others, everyone redeemed by the shed blood of Christ has been given access to divine inheritance and procurement of God's promises, that is why you must do everything in your capacity to be amongst God's favourite who is duly granted provision to enjoy…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 05: Not Breaking Ranks
items.big_idea: Looking at Joel 2:7-8, A disciple of Christ must be discipline, united, spiritually aligned and be obedient, staying in his or her God given assigned position, an army of Christ are always in right place, no weapon can stop them. God's army are always charged and ready to enforce divine order.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 06: Strength to Overcome
items.big_idea: As we go through the journey of life, enough strength is required, in Isaiah 40:29, bible says Almighty God is always ready to give power to the tired and worn out and strength to the weak, there is none that never suffer exhaustion but we need God's grace to recharge for next assignment. When going through ten virgin's story in Matthew 25:1-10, your readin…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 07: God's Best Friends
items.big_idea: It may surprise you to know that God has best friends, they are so close to Him that they know things about Him that no one else knows. They are people with experiential knowledge of God that most people don't have. They don't talk deeply on how much they know God so that people will not misunderstand them.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 08: Long Suffering
items.big_idea: Longsuffering means enduring injury, offense, delay or provocation without revenge. It is patience under pressure. It is the strength to keep loving and forgiving when quitting seems easier. This nature is in God: slow to anger, giving room for repentance. Longsuffering is not weakness; it is controlled strength. Every believer is called to reflect this cha…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 09: Faithful to the End
items.big_idea: The Christian journey is not a sprint but a marathon. It requires consistency, perseverance, and faithfulness until the very end. Many people start well but lose focus along the way due to distractions, trials, or worldly pleasures. However, God expects every believer to remain steadfast and faithful until the race is fully run. Our eternal reward depends n…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 10: Faithful in Little
items.big_idea: The Almighty God tests with little before trusting us with much. Men celebrate results, God celebrates faithfulness. In Luke 19, Jesus shows that God's promotion in the kingdom is not accidental - it is the reward for faithfulness in seemingly small matters.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 11: Heaven Bound Home
items.big_idea: The world had never experienced the kind of darkness ravaging homes and destinies of men as we have it today. There is a massive resurgence of ungodliness in families, communities and lack of respect for the Creator of the universe. This must not continue in our families, we must end it. The simplest way of dealing with the darkness ravaging homes is the ap…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 12: Despise Not
items.big_idea: Despise not is one of the key words in the scripture, This serves as a warning and it should not be treated as unimportant. It is a call to honour and value a person, an instruction, a gift, or situation. It should be taken seriously, it should not be despised, it may be a pointer to your deliverance.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 13: Neighbourhood Evangelism
items.big_idea: Give a copy of house fellowship manual to souls around and also go out and win soul for Christ.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 14: Go Borrow Vessels
items.big_idea: Go borrow vessels is a divine instruction to everyone, vessels that will be used to carry breakthroughs which will take care of needs beyond your reach. God always releases a prophetic command that unlocks abundance. This lesson reveals to us that the answer to our requests lies in obedience, preparation and faith in God.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 15: The Principal Thing
items.big_idea: It is written, Wisdom is the principal thing, and we are admonished to get wisdom (Proverbs 4:7). Principal means important, consequential or influential. Wisdom is a must have for every believer which is why the Word of God tells us to ask the Lord for wisdom if we lack it (James 1:5). God expects us to place wisdom as a top priority in our desires. It is…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 16: One Thing Is Needful
items.big_idea: Father, create in me a deep hunger and thirst for Your world.
primary_passages: Luke 10: 38-42 INTRODUCTION. One thing is needful, that's what Jesus says to Martha in Luke 10:38-42. Five verses that spoke about two sisters with polar opposite of attitudes and actions. From it, we learned about what Jesus desire from us above all things

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 17: Get Dominion
items.big_idea: Father, I receive the grace to walk in dominion You have ordained for me.
primary_passages: Joshua 1:3-8 INTRODUCTION. Dominion is God's delegated authority to all His children redeemed by the blood of His Son, Jesus'. It is an authority given to believers to represent Almighty God on earth with the mandate to execute divine will and establish God's counsel to mankind. Man was made by God to rule, subdue and overcome; therefore, every child of the Most High God has the DNA of dominion

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 18: Unstoppable Assembly
items.big_idea: In Leviticus 26:7, bible says the unstoppable assembly shall chase their enemies and their enemies shall fall by the sword before them; an unstoppable assembly is not defined by numbers, 2 Chronicles 20:1-20, weapons or human strength but by having divine backing, unity, unalloyed dedication and a sense of purpose to the call or assignment. They are God-led…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 19: Game Changers
items.big_idea: Father, arise and change every negative pattern in my life.
primary_passages: Acts 4:29-33 INTRODUCTION. In every life, there is a moment when everything changes, goals, careers, decisions that shift the outcome of things. In life and destiny, God specializes in game changing moments. When God comes into an awkward situation, the rule changes, the direction and end result will also change. Game changer can turn night to morning, sorrow to joy and sickness to wholeness

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 20: Hope for the Hopeless
items.big_idea: Father, breathe life into every dead situation in my life.
primary_passages:
Luke 7:11-15

INTRODUCTION. HOPELESS means a state where a person feels that there is no possibility of improvement, help, or positive change. It is the feeling that a situation is beyond solution or recovery. To be hopeless is to believe that nothing good will happen again, efforts are useless, Luke 5:1-7, future holds no promise but when hope is enacted the future promises will be established and efforts will be compensated with fruitful results

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 21: Misused Opportunity
items.big_idea: Father, restore every good opportunity I have misused knowingly or unknowingly.
primary_passages: 2 Kings 5:1-27 INTRODUCTION. Opportunities are divine privileges. When God places His children near power, servants, and His work, He is giving them chance to grow in character and destiny had a rare opportunity - to serve a prophet, learn obedience, and inherit greatness - but he misused that opportunity and paid a heavy price. Opportunity can lift you or ruin you, depending on you handle it

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 22: Overcoming Self
items.big_idea: Father, deliver me from the power of self that wars against Your will in my life.
primary_passages:
Romans 12:1-2

INTRODUCTION. One of the greatest battles a believer fights is not against the devil, people or challenging issues, but against self. Self wants comfort like Jonah inside the raging storm, recognition like Absalom, and control like Korah, Dathan and Abiram and independence like the prodigal son. Until self is conquered, destiny will suffer and testimonies will be hindered

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 23: Overcoming the World
items.big_idea: Father, empower me by the Holy Spirit to live above the pressures and temptations of this world.
primary_passages: 1 John 5:4-5 INTRODUCTION. Believers may be living in this world but they are not to live based on the worldly system, though the world system may pressure us to sin, fear, pride, lust, unbelief but as Christians we ought to take our stand in faith and purity of hearts. God never called us to be defeated by the world; He called us to overcome it. Overcoming the world and its system is not by human strength but by divine life and faith in Christ

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 24: Christians and Politics Part 1
items.big_idea: Father, we enthrone You as the King over nations.
primary_passages:
Genesis 41:38-41

INTRODUCTION. Politics refers to the activities associated with the governance of a country or an area. Psalm 24:1 tells us that the earth belongs to our God and all the people that live in the world because He is the Maker, Deuteronomy 10:14. As the Owner and Maker of the earth, God remains in charge of the governance of every nation and kingdom (Psalm 47:2) but gives authority to men at different times to be in governance taking instructions from Him as the King of Kings. Daniel 2:21

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 25: Christians and Politics Part 2
items.big_idea: Father, we enthrone You as the King over the nations.
primary_passages: Daniel 6:3-5 INTRODUCTION. Politics refers to the activities associated with the governance of a country or area. Psalm 24:1 tells us that the earth belongs to our God and all the people that live in the world because He is the Maker, Deuteronomy 10:14. As the Owner and Maker of the earth, God remains in charge of the governance of every nation and kingdom (Psalm 47:2) but gives authority to men at different times to be in governance taking instructions from Him as the King of Kings. Daniel 2:21. We will be studying the biblical guideline for God's children in politics

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 26: House Fellowship Awareness Day
items.big_idea: Hanging of House Fellowship Banners in Centres/ Exchange of Gifts as A Sign of Love and Unity

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 27: Divine Assets or Divine Liabilities?
items.big_idea: Father, thank You for counting me worthy to be used in Your divine agenda.
primary_passages:
Genesis 18:17-22

INTRODUCTION. In kingdom business people are evaluated as assets or liabilities depending on Your fellowship and closeness to the will of God. The Almighty God also assesses lives whether productive or inactive, God looks at individuals not by their wealth or status, but by their spiritual value, obedience and alignment with God's purpose

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 28: The Purpose Must Not Be Changed
items.big_idea: Father, I thank You because your purpose for my life is unchangeable.
primary_passages: Daniel 6:15-22 INTRODUCTION. Every life has a divine purpose, some purposes are attacked, delayed, or challenged - but they must not be changed. Jealous men plotted against Daniel and manipulated the king into signing a decree but later the counsel of God prevailed

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 29: When Success Turns to Pride
items.big_idea: Father, convert every breakthrough designed to destroy me to glory.
primary_passages:
2 Chronicles 26:1-23

INTRODUCTION. King Uzziah is one of the most striking examples in scripture of a man who began well, rose greatly, but ended poorly. His life teaches us that divine success must be handled with humility or it can become a trap

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 30: Desires of Heaven Bound
items.big_idea: Father, plant in my heart a deep hunger for You above all earthly things.
primary_passages:
Colossians 3:1-16

INTRODUCTION Heaven bound means destined for heaven, it describes a person or soul on a spiritual journey towards a celestial afterlife, it implies being saved, born again and living righteously to reach eternal life. It's a life lived with eternity in mind

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 31: Cherish God's Privacy
items.big_idea: Father, help me to fear You genuinely so I can receive Your secrets.
primary_passages: Deuteronomy 29:29 INTRODUCTION. In a world where everyone wants instant access to information, God values discretion and intimacy, God will reveal deeper purposes only to the humble and the reverent. The prerequisite of having deeper intimacy with God is in having godly fear

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 32: My Home
items.big_idea: Everyone desires a home; a home is a place of belonging, safety and ultimate peace. There are two types of homes; one is earthly, which is temporary and the other is heavenly, which is eternal. Our focus today is HEAVEN.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 33: The Waiting Room
items.big_idea: The most difficult place to be in life is the waiting room: a laboratory, a hospital, an interview, an examination, or waiting on God for a particular miracle. Our focus today is the WAITING ROOM OF GOD: waiting on God may be one of the most difficult aspects of the Christian life. In the book of Acts 1, Jesus commanded His disciples to wait for the promise.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 34: Prison Break Part 1
items.big_idea: What comes to mind when you hear the word "Prison"? (Physical confinement, bars, cells). Prison is a place of confinement, where one is kept involuntarily or voluntarily. Prison extends beyond the physical, encompassing spiritual, mental, and emotional bondage, and how our Almighty God is the ultimate Liberator, capable of breaking every chain!

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 35: Prison Break Part 2
items.big_idea: What comes to mind when you hear the word "Prison"? (Physical confinement, bars, cells). Prison is a place of confinement, where one is kept involuntarily or voluntarily. Prison extends beyond the physical, encompassing spiritual, mental; And emotional bondage, and how our Almighty God is the Ultimate Liberator, capable of breaking every chain.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 36: The Heart of a Helper
items.big_idea: The heart of a helper is a heart transformed by God's love, compelled by comparison, and committed to action, seeing Christ in every person in need. For us as believers, helping isn't just a good deed; it's a profound expression of our faith. It's not merely an action, but a reflection of a deeper reality within us.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 37: Social Media
items.big_idea: Our world has evolved over the years, it has experienced the stone age, the industrial age and now we live in the postindustrial or information age. One key thing that came in this age of information is social media. As Christians, understanding times and seasons and how to live and work with it matters, John 17:14-16, 1 Chronicles 12:32. We need to accept…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 38: Children Are Your Tomorrow
items.big_idea: A child is expected to be a better version of his or her parents. Your child is supposed to be a new improved you, your child is your future hence losing your child to the devil amounts to losing your life while gaining your child is gaining your future. Never surrender your child to bad company or influence, guide and nurture him/her to become an improved…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 39: Neighbourhood Csr/Welfare
items.big_idea: Thank you Father for the salvation of my soul.
tags: End Of The Third Quarter/Interractive Session

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 40: Overcomer's Spirit
items.big_idea: 1 John 4:4 tells us that regardless of our age, level, background, tribe, race, etc., the moment we become God's children, we will overcome whatever comes our way because we are God's children. The Lord dwell in us and He is greater than whatever problem or challenge that may come our way. As believers, we are called to be overcomers through faith in Christ…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 41: Special Heritage
items.big_idea: In Zechariah 2:8, God declared that we are the apple of His eyes and His heritage, whatever untoward affects us affects our God and He will rise to solve the problem. Hebrews 4:15. Isaiah 49:16 tells us that He has engraved us in the palm of His hands. What God needs from us is to know how dear we are to Him and trust Him to shower us with His love. Proverb…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 42: Control Your Appetite
items.big_idea: Appetite is not evil if it is positive and not character damaging or bringing insults to the body of Christ but lack of control is the problem. Uncontrolled appetite has destroyed destinies, homes, etc.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 43: The Peacemaker
items.big_idea: Peace is not the absence of trouble or discontentment, it is the presence of God navigating His influence of establishing God's order. God does not only call us to have peace, but to make peace. A peace maker is not weak but a Christ inspired being.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 44: The Divine Edit Part One
items.big_idea: We live in an age of abundance - abundant information, choices, demands on our time and attention. Our lives often feel overflowing, overscheduled and overwhelmed. Just as a write edits a manuscript, a filmmaker edits footage, or a gardener prunes a plant we need a process of editing our lives.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 45: The Divine Edit Part Two
items.big_idea: Last week we examined divine edit part one, focusing on the need to remove the clutter that fills our lives and the signs of a cluttered life. Today we will be explore the practical steps of a cluttered life and the tools needed for editing.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 46: Don't Be Careless
items.big_idea: Carelessness is acting without attention, discipline or reverence. Many people lose great things in life not because of Satan alone but because they are careless. Spiritual gifts, marriages, opportunities, health and destiny have been lost through carelessness.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 47: Progress with Speed
items.big_idea: Promotion can come to you either human or divine assistance. The assisted state of progress attained through this promotion moves you to the next level you are not supposed to be, may the Lord in this season assist you and move you to a level you are not qualified to occupy in Jesus name.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 48: Go Sin No More
items.big_idea: Sin is primarily any act that is against the laws, will, plan and purpose of God which encompasses our actions, our thoughts, words and omissions. Our God is pure and cannot tolerate sin. Hab. 1:13, Isaiah 59:1-2. Whenever we commit sin, we are challenging the Lordship of God over our lives and submitting to the ownership and authority of the devil over our…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 49: Love, the Fruit of Holy Spirit
items.big_idea: Love is the fruit of the Holy Spirit, Galatians 5:22. When we love, it is evidence that the Spirit of God lives in us, 1 John 4:13, 16. He enables us to love like God loves. God manifested His love by sending Jesus Christ as a sacrifice to take away our sins. If God loves us this much, we ought to love each other not by our power but by power of the Holy Sp…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 50: When God Hides You
items.big_idea: It is wisdom to obey when He instruct you to hide. Known unto God are all His works from the foundation of the world. He will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are stayed on Him because they trust in Him, Isaiah 26:3. There is time for everything, Ecclesiastes 3:1-11. Our Bible text shows us that God the Father instructed Joseph to hide our Lord Jesus…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2027 — Week 51: Home of the Righteous
items.big_idea: The righteous keeps the way of the Lord to do justice and judgement and this is more acceptable of the Lord than sacrifice, Proverbs 21:3. Abraham became a mighty nation, and all nations of the earth are blessed in him just as the Lord promised because God judged him faithful. Romans 4:17-18. God blessed Abraham because He knew Abraham will teach his childr…

items.big_idea: LOVE FEAST/ THANKSGIVING/ EVALUATION OF THE JUST ENDED YEAR AND DELIBERATIONS ON HOW TO MOVE OUR CENTERS FORWARD. a. Leader and member should discuss challenges confronting the centre. b. Suggestions that can foster growth of house fellowship. c. The materials used this year, what is of quality or not? d. Is the environment where the centre is conducive or…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 02: Watch Your Back
items.big_idea: In our present world, many are losing the battle of life as a result of care free life, uncontrolled desires has made many to end their mission on earth abruptly that is why God's presence for divine leading in any task or action, discipline and vigilance are needful to race through and end well.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 03: Not Over Yet
items.big_idea: Believers should have it at their mind that God decides when it is over, a condemned case of Lazarus with stinking dead body in John 11 received divine attention and reversal that is why you don't need to be discouraged in your challenging situation, know that God has good plan for you.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 04: Cancerous Cell Part 1
items.big_idea: The leaders should remind the members that challenges of life has expiring date but we need to trust God, our Redeemer knows what to do to those issues.

items.big_idea: The leaders should remind the members of what cancerous cell is and how to identify it.

items.big_idea: The leaders should remind the members of lesson treated last week on the betrayals, their attributes and the need for believers to stand firm against their tricks.

items.big_idea: “I will overturn, overturn, overturn it and it shall be no more, until he comes whose right it is; and I will give it him”. Ezekiel 21:27.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 18: Prison Break?
items.big_idea: Father, blast into pieces on this day every prison enemy may be keeping lives and destiny of members of this house fellowship centre .

items.big_idea: The leaders should remind the members on lesson discussed on prison break that enemy's intentions on believers.

items.big_idea: “And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God”. Rom 8:27

items.big_idea: Father, give me special encounter that will increase my value and commitment in 2026.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 23: Brokenness
items.big_idea: “The Lord is near unto them that are of a broken heart, and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit”. Psalm 34:18

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 24: Procastination
items.big_idea: Father, please help me to be diligent in whatever assignment being committed into my hands.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 25: Remember Vashti
items.big_idea: Whatever God has deposited in your life is for a purpose and you must ensure that you don't abuse it. We shall examine the life of a queen called Vashti and the consequences of her behavior.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 26: House Fellowship Awareness Day
items.big_idea: Hanging of House Fellowship Banners in Centres/ Exchange of Gifts as A Sign of Love and Unity.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 27: Dare To Be Different.
items.big_idea: Just as it is for a tree to be identified by its fruit, so it is for any generation of people to be identified by its character (Matthew 7:16-20). Every generation has its own uniqueness. Daniel refused to concur to devastating agenda to his future which later pave the way for his life of influence and affluence in a strange land.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 28: Make Your Life Count
items.big_idea: Jesus Christ lived a perfect life, His impact is everlasting. Phil.2:5-11. As His sons and daughters, we should live our lives to positively impact others for commitment, service, love and dedication to our God like Apostle Paul. 1 Cor.11:1. There is assurance of divine rewards now and when we meet in glory.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 29: Like A Roaring Lion
items.big_idea: The Holy Spirit in 1 Timothy 4:1-3 warns us that that there will be seducing spirits, evil doctrines, wiles of the devil all these are deplored seeking to derail believers from the path of truth. This is why Apostle Paul admonishes us in our memory verse to be sober and vigilant so that we will not fall prey to the devil's antics.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 30: Keeping Fit
items.big_idea: Keeping fit is the activity of keeping your body in good condition. This is very important as we need our bodies in good condition to accomplish life's goals and serve God effectively and flawlessly. Our daily activities should be anchored on spiritual development too, when your spirit is whole, your body will effect divine purpose.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 31: Idols
items.big_idea: idols are objects or persons that are not God but are worshipped as if they are God. People who worship idols are called idolaters. Examples of idols - shrines and evil altars.

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 32: Zoe (God Kind Of Life)
items.big_idea: Zoe is a Greek word for life. Biblically, it is defined as “eternal life or God kind of life”. John 17:3. It means the rich abundant divine nature of God, His fullness of love, of joy, power and abilities. 1 John 5:2

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 33: The Compromised Believer
items.big_idea: The compromised believer is one who has turned back from following the Lord, given place to the devil and is now under his control. He has forsaken the way of the Lord and follows his own way. As a result, he is untrustworthy because the spirit influencing his actions is unholy. We shall be looking at biblical examples of compromised believers and how to av…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 34: Beware Of Ravening Wolves
items.big_idea: False prophets (ravening wolves) are “so called prophets” who prophesy lies. They claim their prophecy is of God, but it is false. Their aim is to deceive people with their false prophesy by peaching destructive heresies amongst believers (2 Peter 2:1). These false prophets even show signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, the very elect (Matthew 24:24).…

items.title: House Fellowship Manuals 2026 — Week 35: Living In The End Time
items.big_idea: We are warned that difficult times shall signal the last days.
